priorities.finding: Prioritize and retain impression-time request-context features tab, hour, and weekday. Training-only temporal screening shows the only positive primary lift (+0.00221) with full coverage, while daily lift is positive on 3 of 4 days. The observed official validation GAUC is 0.66937 and primary is 0.60302, supporting continued use but not a large expansion of budget.
priorities.recommended_action: Proceed with request_context as the sole feature addition, run the next confirmation experiment, and apply early stopping to further feature-group exploration unless confirmation shows a material gain.

priorities.finding: Investigate tab-specific failure before scaling. Tab 8 has severely weak within-user ranking evidence (GAUC 0.35185, nDCG@5 0.02634), and tabs 3 and 0 also have GAUC near or below 0.54 with substantially depressed top-five metrics. This is a localized weakness rather than evidence that the globally useful request context should be discarded.
priorities.recommended_action: Perform slice-level error analysis and assess fallback, candidate-quality, or calibration treatment for weak tabs; do not spend budget on additional screened feature groups until this is understood.

avoid: Reject user_profile, historical_user_author_affinity, upload_recency, content_duration, item_metadata, historical_author_response, and historical_item_response because their training-only primary lifts are negative; do not promote them without new causal or temporal evidence.

Do not treat user_positive_count:zero as ranking degradation: its GAUC is 0.5 and all top-five metrics are zero because the retrospective slice has no positives, so it is not actionable ranking evidence.
Do not introduce current-impression outcome fields or aggregate snapshots lacking per-impression availability timestamps; they are unavailable at ranking time or vulnerable to leakage.
metric_diagnosis: The experiment provides credible overall within-user ranking performance (GAUC 0.66937) and useful top-five quality (nDCG@5 0.53667, MAP@5 0.48542), but the two views diverge in some slices. For example, several hour segments have GAUC around 0.59-0.66 while nDCG@5 remains around 0.35-0.39, indicating weaker top-five concentration despite moderate pairwise ordering. Tab 8 is a genuine severe failure on both GAUC and top-five metrics, whereas user_positive_count:zero is primarily a label-support artifact. Overall, retain request_context, investigate the weak tab slices, and stop adding rejected feature groups under the strict early-stopping budget.
